Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Sent · Just now

JoJo · AI

JoJo · AI says:

Yes, damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.

Damaged items / delivery issues: You should contact our support team with your order details and photos of the damage. We then review and may offer a replacement, refund, repair, or redelivery, and return shipping may be covered if the item is faulty or sent incorrectly.
Normal returns: We accept returns of unused items in original packaging within 30 days. For these standard returns, return shipping costs are your responsibility, and refunds are processed within 5–10 working days after we receive the item.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
